name: Casting Waves of Time grants Warped Reality (#1929)
contract: Warping Reality 504602 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Warped Reality 504603, a 10 s self-buff whose aura 313 is class-masked to SpellFamilyFlags word1 33554944 = Unmake + Melt Reality and is read by type in Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving, but Spell.dbc gives 504602 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated nothing and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0, leaving the buff unreachable. Its tooltip is "Casting Waves of Time now grants you Warped Reality for $504603d", and the record's own ProcChance is 100, so one Waves of Time cast must grant it every time - one cast is therefore already deterministic. The new row uses SpellPhaseMask 1 (PROC_SPELL_PHASE_CAST): the tooltip's trigger is casting, the buff is a movement permission that cannot depend on the cone connecting, and Spell.cpp's CAST-phase Unit::ProcSkillsAndAuras call fires once per non-triggered cast with no target required.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Warped Reality buff before any cast
Casting Waves of Time grants Warped Reality
